item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 09/Mar/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A moderate easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. It will be rather warm during the day over the region. The northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coastal areas later on Sunday, it will be slightly cooler and windier over the region. Under the influence of the monsoon, the weather will be mainly fine and dry over Guangdong early to midweek next week.
